claim: South Island is referred to as the "mainland" by South Island residents.

evidence.title: South Island
evidence.text: It has a 32 percent larger landmass than the North Island so is sometimes referred to as the " mainland " of New Zealand , especially by South Island residents , but only 23 percent of New Zealand 's million inhabitants live there .

evidence.title: South Island (South Australia)
evidence.text: South Island (also called Peter Island , South Islet and West Bay Island) is an island located in the Australian state of South Australia at the south end of Pondalowie Bay on the south-west extremity of Yorke Peninsula about 11 km north-west by west of the town of Stenhouse Bay .

evidence.title: South Island
evidence.text: The South Island or Te Waipounamu (Māori) is the larger of the two major islands of New Zealand , the other being the smaller but more populous North Island .

evidence.title: South Island (disambiguation)
evidence.text: The South Island is the southern of the two main islands of New Zealand .

claim: Moves Like Jagger is on Overexposed.

evidence.title: Overexposed (album)
evidence.text: Its title is a smirking allusion to Levine 's ubiquity , while its sound is a reflection of how the group wishes to retain the large audience they won once again with " Moves Like Jagger " .

evidence.title: Overexposed (album)
evidence.text: The album was recorded between 2011 and 2012 and was driven after the moderate success of their third album , Hands All Over (2010) , and later by the enormous success of the re-released edition , which was promoted by the single " Moves Like Jagger " , recorded as a collaboration with Christina Aguilera .

evidence.title: Moves like Jagger
evidence.text: " Moves Like Jagger " is a song by American band Maroon 5 featuring recording artist Christina Aguilera , released by A&M Octone Records on June 21 , 2011 , as the fourth and final single from the re-release of the group 's third studio album Hands All Over (2010) .

evidence.title: Moves like Jagger
evidence.text: " Moves Like Jagger " is a dance-pop and electropop song and is backed by synths and electronic drums .

evidence.title: Moves like Jagger
evidence.text: Likewise , the song was a commercial success , going on to top the charts in over 18 countries .
